soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.58–0.61, lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior part slightly widened, posterior margin slightly arcuate and convex. Frontal peaks slightly raised, slightly concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at its tip shortly needle-shaped, apical and subapical setae both present. Mandibles rather straight, the apex strongly curved but the curved part very short, mandibular basal ridge present, thickened below the middle; length 0.54–0.57 of head capsule length and 0.91–0.97 of head width. Antennae 17 segments. Widest part of the postmentum between the anterior seventh and the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins nearly parallel and then slightly spreading; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.27–0.31. Pronotum somewhat trapezoidal, about 1.56–1.66 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the V-shaped incision at the middle of the anterior margin very shallow; 4–6 long setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
